scope: Scoped follow-up to user review: chart tooltip placement, contextual editor menus, cookie consent, file browser inset and reorder/date geometry. Production owners and their actual Storybook consumers were changed together.
changes: Core Chart disables only tooltip position animation; first painted hover labels retain measured coordinates, data and independent semantic tables.
Map/video/table/executable contexts consume compact shared Core ToolbarSurface. Table command groups align in one row; width readouts have aligned glyphs and a named status/resize description.
Executable floating menus retain alignment/deletion; source and runtime actions remain inline. Native title/Monaco focus suppresses unrelated selection menus.

Cookie banner/account settings expose one analytics draft and explicit rejection/save actions. Redundant disclosure and accept-all actions were removed; persistence, renewal, schema and provider gating remain.
File browser toolbar and grid/list share one Core inset. Grid/list selection is preserved and nested list landmarks have unique localized names.
Core grip hover/pickup feedback strengthens glyph ink on transparent stable leading targets. DateRange uses intrinsic groups and numeric date focus uses a text underline.

boundaries: Earlier full 1,313-state and title-only runs retain their own snapshot identities and do not establish coverage of later source.
Archive/page-section/Form Builder reorder consumers still lack an explicit non-drag click/tap alternative. Keyboard/drag support alone does not establish WCAG 2.5.7 acceptance.
Automated axe, DOM/keyboard checks and fine-pointer viewport emulation do not establish physical touch or native VoiceOver/Orca acceptance.
Page fixtures do not establish real backend persistence, account synchronization, external analytics/maps/media transport, design approval or deployment.
